'''Lucius Rothingham''' was a former [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] working for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] as a [[Spy/Legends|spy]]. His Imperial career also involved kidnapping, interrogation and sometimes killing. He was a born pragmatist and loved serving the Empire, seeing the regime as a means of keeping order in the [[Galaxy/Legends|Galaxy]], and his conscience was subordinated by his desire to serve well. A well-educated man with a broad knowledge base, he was adept at technical matters, and had an annoying habit of using mechanical and technical metaphors in his speech. He reported to [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Anton Kale]]. After the Empire's fall, Rothingmam would still strive to maintain its ideals, and worked toward its eventual restoration. He had several [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoos]] on his arms and chest.<ref name="CCW" />
